DIAGNOSIS_is_it_overfitting.short_answer: NO -- the model is not currently overfitting at its operating point. Overfitting is the WALL THAT PINS THE ONE WORKING LEVER AT ITS MINIMUM SETTING. Read this before proposing any data or regularisation lever.

three_statements_that_look_contradictory.overfitting_is_NOT_binding: Scope = TEXT TOWER + OPTIMIZER. Epochs 23->14 moved R@10 +0.06pp (0.1084->0.1090). 6B-3: lower head_lr REMOVED the late-epoch rollover entirely (arm ends at its max, no decline) and the PLATEAU HEIGHT DID NOT MOVE (0.119 vs 0.122). THIS IS THE DECISIVE EXPERIMENT: it eliminated the overfitting SYMPTOM and the ceiling did not move, so whatever sets the ceiling is not overfitting.
three_statements_that_look_contradictory.the_image_tower_memorises: Scope = ViT AT ELEVATED vit_lr. 6G-1: train/clip_loss 1.17 -> 0.702 -> 0.113 -> 0.037 as vit_lr 1e-6->3e-5, while val/clip_loss RISES 2.585 -> 3.487. Overfit onset moves earlier monotonically: best step 4750 -> 3250 -> 2500 -> 1750.
three_statements_that_look_contradictory.binding_constraint_is_the_image_represen: Scope = THE ACTUAL DIAGNOSIS. 6C: every text-side and objective-side lever null; both positives ever recorded are image-side.

DIAGNOSIS_is_it_overfitting.real_characterisation: 'Amount of image adaptation' = DEPTH x LR x SCOPE and all three are now measured out: depth PHYSICALLY EXHAUSTED (12/12 ViT-B/16 blocks), scope NULL (0.1704 vs 0.1714), LR an INVERTED-U with 1e-6 already optimal. No dose left to give. The optimum is pinned at 1e-6 -- three orders below head_lr -- because it is 85.1M trainable image params against 27,570 images. THE MODEL SITS AT THE OVERFITTING KNEE: not broken by overfitting, DOSE-LIMITED by it. Mild real overfitting does exist at the canonical point (best step 4750/6000, mild late rise; the 6G-7 protocol cost 2.55pp at vit=12 vs 0.26pp at vit=2 is precisely a measurement of how much) -- but no points are being LOST to it; the loss is the points turning the lever up WOULD have bought.
DIAGNOSIS_is_it_overfitting.consequence_for_phase9: CHANGES WHAT COUNTS AS SUCCESS. WRONG framing 'more data fixes overfitting' predicts the current number rises on its own. RIGHT framing 'more data moves the knee right' predicts the vit_lr optimum SHIFTS RIGHT of 1e-6 and the peak is higher -- that is 9C's pre-registered prediction and the correct test. THEREFORE: if 9B (data only, recipe unchanged) barely moves, THAT IS NOT A FAILURE, it is the expected result under the correct mechanism. 9C is where the effect must appear.
DIAGNOSIS_is_it_overfitting.indiana_caveat: Indiana is flat within noise on EVERY variant tested (0.0390-0.0485, SE 0.76pp). That is a DOMAIN-DIVERSITY problem, not overfitting -- and full MIMIC is more of the SAME domain. Expect partial help at best; do NOT bank the Indiana gate on it. That is what 9G and VinDr-CXR are for.
DIAGNOSIS_is_it_overfitting.after_the_pivot: For REPORT GENERATION the blocker is neither overfitting nor data -- there is NO IMAGE-CONDITIONED DECODER AT ALL (hybrid_lm.py:147 forward() takes only input_ids). That is a capability gap, and it is Phase 10. The overfitting question belongs to the retrieval chapter and is now answered and closed.

FIX: build_mimic_cxr_local.py rewritten to use session-cookie auth. _get_session() reads ~/.physionet_session (chmod 600, raw sessionid value only) and raises loudly if absent -- no silent fallback to a Basic-Auth path known not to work. rejected_by_prior_evidence.rerunning_stage0_from_scratch: ASKED 2026-08-16 -- NO. (1) Backbone quality was MEASURED not to transfer: PPL 15.62 -> 13.18 moved retrieval FLAT, null #1 of 10. (2) Stage 0 trains on PUBMED ABSTRACTS; the full-MIMIC build changes nothing it sees -- the two are orthogonal. (3) The 13.18 checkpoint is hard-won (four failed runs, collapse at steps 3k/24k/28k, resolved only by the fp32 Mamba-scan + mLSTM-exp-gate fix) and costs ~3 DAYS of H100 wall; re-running re-exposes that fragility for zero expected gain. HONEST NUANCE THE PIVOT INTRODUCES: the null was measured on RETRIEVAL, which uses the backbone as an ENCODER (pooled embedding); report generation uses it as a GENERATOR (autoregressive decoding = exactly what LM pretraining optimises), so the null does NOT automatically carry over. That argues for KEEPING the 13.18 checkpoint, not rebuilding it. The legitimate cheap version is Phase 10G (domain-adaptive continuation on ~47M tokens of MIMIC report text, hours not days, run as an ablation against the untouched 13.18 control).
